shared_elements: band or panel of repeated motifs bordering the figural field
figure(s) shown against a plain flat ground
justification: Both surfaces are low reliefs that set a figural form against a plain ground with an adjoining band of small repeated motifs, but this is a very generic correspondence. A shows a legible, well-proportioned procession of multiple profile human figures with a camel, staff and gift-bearing gestures framed by rosette registers, while B shows a single massive, indistinct body form beside a narrow strip of curvilinear/linear signs, with no procession, animals or shared postures or attributes.
